_comment: Per-team board start-gate configuration.
XACA-1083 — per-team "require Epic" / "require Release" board settings
(child of EACA-0010). Plan doc: kanban/XACA-1083_require_epic_release_settings.md
GATE POINT: enforcement happens at item START (kb-pick / kb-run), never at
kb-backlog add — an item cannot carry an epic at creation time (chicken-and-egg
with the Project Planner flow). See the plan doc's 'Design Decisions' section.
FAIL-CLOSED CONTRACT (booleans): an absent file, unreadable file, malformed
JSON, a team missing from 'teams', or a non-boolean value for either
'requireEpicOnStart' / 'requireReleaseOnStart' (including the strings
"true"/"false", 0, 1, or null) MUST resolve to true (required) at the
loader. Never resolve bad input to 'allow'. See aiteamforge_paths.py
is_epic_required_for_team() / is_release_required_for_team(), and
subjects/testing-rigor/S004 for why a check that can't read its own config
must not render as the permissive result.
GRANDFATHER CUTOFF: 'grandfatherCutoff' is a single ISO-8601 UTC timestamp.
An item is exempt from BOTH gates only when its creation timestamp (the
item-JSON field named by 'creationTimestampField', below) parses AND is
strictly before this cutoff. A missing or malformed cutoff — or a missing
or unparseable item timestamp — resolves to 'not exempt' (the gate
applies). This is deliberately the SAME fail-closed direction as the
booleans above: when this file, or the item it is checking, cannot be
trusted, the gate wins. Never resolve bad input to 'everything is exempt'.
See aiteamforge_paths.py is_item_grandfathered().
'creationTimestampField' names the item-JSON field the shell gate reads to
get an item's creation instant. MEASURED 2026-09-25 (XACA-1083-001 sibling
input): the field is 'addedAt' — 0 of 709 open items across all 7 live
boards are missing it, and neither 'createdAt' nor 'created' exists
anywhere in the item schema. Left configurable here (rather than
hardcoded in the loader) purely so a future schema rename is a one-line
edit instead of a grep-and-replace across kanban-helpers.sh — the value
itself is confirmed, not provisional.
Subitems are OUT OF SCOPE for this gate: they carry no epicId/release of
their own and 'kb-backlog sub start' is not gated today (not even on
points, XACA-0624's same precedent) — see XACA-1083-001 sibling note.
'command' ships with BOTH settings false (12 of 12 open items are
orphaned — a 100% pre-existing miss makes a mandate impractical for that
team; see the plan doc's Measured Baseline). Every other team defaults to
true/true per the plan doc's Requirement #3.
